name: SpinQuant research harness (fake-quant + Triton INT4 kernels)
notable_features: Cayley SGD on the Stiefel manifold to learn rotation matrices R1,R2 (and online Hadamard R3,R4)
Evaluated largely with fake quantization, plus research Triton INT4 GEMM kernels
Two variants: SpinQuant_no_had (rotations merged into weights, zero forward-pass change) and SpinQuant_had (needs online Hadamard kernels)
hardware_caveats: NO hardware INT4 tensor-core path: W4A4KV4 accuracy is a fake-quant / research-kernel result, not a silicon result
SpinQuant_had needs an online Hadamard kernel, ~8% of network latency overhead per the paper
best_for: understanding what W4A4 costs when activations AND KV cache are quantized
notes: Recorded because the SpinQuant W4A4 quality deltas are harness numbers, and 'there is no INT4 tensor-core path for 4x4' is the whole point of the format record. The rotation matrices are ~0.26% of weight size and are folded into the checkpoint.
